14:  *   - every little-endian unsigned 64-bit word in the first 64 KB, plus
15:  *   - every little-endian unsigned 64-bit word in the last 64 KB.
16:  *
17:  * The published OSHash reference requires at least 128 KB (131,072 bytes) so the head and
18:  * tail chunks never overlap. Arithmetic is performed mod 2^64 (natural [Long] overflow).
19:  * The result is rendered as a
20:  * zero-padded 16-char lowercase hex string, matching the reference implementation/test
21:  * vectors.
22:  */
23: object OpenSubtitlesHasher {
24: 
25:     private const val CHUNK_SIZE = 64 * 1024 // 64 KB
26:     private const val MIN_FILE_SIZE = CHUNK_SIZE * 2 // 128 KB, per the OSHash reference
27: 
28:     fun hash(file: File): String {
29:         val fileSize = file.length()
30:         require(fileSize >= MIN_FILE_SIZE) {
31:             "File must be at least $MIN_FILE_SIZE bytes for OpenSubtitles hashing"
32:         }
33:         RandomAccessFile(file, "r").use { raf ->
34:             return hash(raf.channel, fileSize)
35:         }
36:     }
37: 
38:     /**
39:      * Same algorithm as [hash], but reading through an already-open [FileDescriptor] and an
40:      * externally-known [fileSize] — used for `content://` URIs (e.g. MediaStore videos under
41:      * scoped storage) where there is no plain [File] path to construct a [RandomAccessFile]
42:      * from directly. Callers typically obtain the descriptor via
43:      * `ContentResolver.openFileDescriptor(uri, "r")` and are responsible for closing it
44:      * (this function only closes the [FileInputStream]/channel it wraps around the
45:      * descriptor, not the descriptor itself).
46:      */
47:     fun hash(fd: FileDescriptor, fileSize: Long): String {
48:         require(fileSize >= MIN_FILE_SIZE) {
49:             "File must be at least $MIN_FILE_SIZE bytes for OpenSubtitles hashing"
50:         }
51:         FileInputStream(fd).channel.use { channel ->
52:             return hash(channel, fileSize)
53:         }
54:     }
55: 
56:     private fun hash(channel: FileChannel, fileSize: Long): String {
57:         var hash = fileSize
58:         hash += sumChunk(channel, 0L)
59:         hash += sumChunk(channel, fileSize - CHUNK_SIZE)
60:         return toHex(hash)
61:     }
62: 
63:     /** Sum the little-endian uint64 words of the 64 KB chunk starting at [offset]. */
64:     private fun sumChunk(channel: FileChannel, offset: Long): Long {
65:         val buffer = ByteBuffer.allocate(CHUNK_SIZE).order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN)
66:         channel.position(offset)
67:         while (buffer.hasRemaining()) {
68:             val read = channel.read(buffer)
69:             if (read < 0) break
70:         }
71:         buffer.flip()
72:         var sum = 0L
73:         val words = CHUNK_SIZE / 8
74:         for (i in 0 until words) {
75:             sum += buffer.long // wraps mod 2^64, which is the intended behaviour
76:         }
77:         return sum
78:     }
79: 
80:     private fun toHex(value: Long): String =
81:         String.format("%016x", value)
82: }

package com.watermelon.app.migration

import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import com.watermelon.common.model.SubtitleCue
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith
import uniffi.watermelon_ffi.bidiFormat
import uniffi.watermelon_ffi.bidiIsRtl
import uniffi.watermelon_ffi.srtParseJson
import uniffi.watermelon_ffi.uniffiEnsureInitialized

/**
 * G1 device evidence after the Rust-only cutover. The expected strings below are copied from
 * the frozen Kotlin-generated oracle in `testdata/golden/*.json`; the Kotlin implementations
 * that produced them were deleted under owner decisions D-7/D-8. No migration flags exist and
 * there is no Kotlin fallback to compare against.
 */
@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class RustDeviceParityTest {

    @Test
    fun native_library_loads_on_art() {
        uniffiEnsureInitialized()
        assertTrue(srtParseJson("no cues here", null).contains("cues"))
    }

    @Test
    fun bidi_matches_frozen_oracle() {
        val cases = listOf(
            Triple("Watermelon 123", false, false to "Watermelon 123"),
            Triple("سلام دنیا", true, true to "سلام دنیا"),
            Triple("سلام hello", true, false to "سلام ⁨hello⁩"),
            Triple("hello سلام", false, false to "hello ⁨سلام⁩"),
            Triple("שלום abc ", true, true to "שלום ⁨abc⁩ "),
            Triple("سلام! 123", false, true to "⁨سلام⁩! 123"),
            Triple("", true, false to ""),
        )
        uniffiEnsureInitialized()
        cases.forEach { (text, baseRtl, expected) ->
            assertEquals("isRtl: $text", expected.first, bidiIsRtl(text))
            assertEquals("format: $text", expected.second, bidiFormat(text, baseRtl))
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun srt_parse_matches_frozen_oracle() {
        val srt = """
            1
            00:00:01,000 --> 00:00:02,500
            hello world

            2
            00:00:03,250 --> 00:00:05,000
            سلام دنیا
            second line (end)
        """.trimIndent()
        val parsed = RustSrtParser.parse(srt, "fa")
        assertEquals("fa", parsed.language)
        assertEquals(
            listOf(
                SubtitleCue(0, 1_000L, 2_500L, "hello world", false, "hello world"),
                SubtitleCue(1, 3_250L, 5_000L, "سلام دنیا\nsecond line (end)", false, "⁨سلام دنیا⁩\nsecond line (end)"),
            ),
            parsed.cues,
        )
    }

    @Test
    fun production_adapters_are_rust_backed() {
        uniffiEnsureInitialized()
        val subtitle = RustSrtParser.parse(
            "00:00:00,000 --> 00:00:01,000\nhello\n", null,
        )
        val signature = RustActivityBuilder.build(subtitle, 0L, 2_000L, 40)
        assertEquals(0L, signature.startMs)
        assertEquals(40, signature.bucketMs)
        assertEquals(50, signature.occupancy.size)

        val probe = RustSrtParser.parse(
            "00:00:10,000 --> 00:00:11,000\nhello\n", null,
        )
        assertEquals(1, RustProbeSelector.select(probe, 60_000L, 3).size)
    }
}

## Objective
- Complete the Kotlin-to-Rust migration by switching production to Rust-only and deleting the ten superseded Kotlin port implementations.
- Keep the Android app/UI, generated UniFFI binding, JNA packaging, native `.so` files and Rust bridge wiring intact.

## Requirements
- All builds/tests/benchmarks/CI verification run in GitHub Actions; no local tests or local toolchain installs.
- Local checks limited to YAML/XML parse, `git diff --check`, and `sha256sum -c`.
- Use `env -u GH_TOKEN gh ...`; `GH_TOKEN` is invalid and overrides the working keyring account.
- Delete only the ten superseded Kotlin port implementations; no Kotlin fallback remains.
- Rollback only via git/release rollback; no in-app rollback switch.
- Do not claim physical-device evidence; only x86_64 API 35 emulator ART evidence exists.
- Preserve the frozen Kotlin-generated oracle; do not silently regenerate or make parity Rust-vs-Rust.

## Decisions
- D-1: continue past G0; evidence in oracle run `45074382455` and JVM baseline run `45075503837`.
- D-2: UniFFI with PCM copy spike; copy cost did not dominate.
- D-3: 1e-6 tolerance for derived floats; bit-exact integers/Long/hash/strings.
- D-4: local-only debug logging, no telemetry/upload.
- D-5: keep pure-Java MP3 encoder in `media-tools`.
- D-6: implementation owner = OpenCode agent session; independent reviewer = SMozaff.
- D-7: owner chose “Superseded Kotlin ports only (Recommended)” — delete the ten oracle-covered Kotlin ports only.
- D-8: owner chose “Rust-only, remove fallback (Recommended)” — Rust is sole runtime; Kotlin fallback/degradation scaffolding removed.
- DD-6 (opt-in reversible cutover) and DD-7 (defer deletion) are superseded by D-7/D-8.
- DD-12: keep `testdata/golden/*.json` and `SHA256SUMS` frozen with `"generator":"kotlin"`; repurpose golden workflow to verification-only; no Rust generator/rebaseline.

## Work State
### Completed
- Golden oracle: 10 JSON files, 39 cases, byte-identical run `45074382455`; local `sha256sum -c` passes.
- JVM baseline: 7 workloads × 20 raw samples via run `45075503837`.
- Rust core ports and parity all green repeatedly; final pre-cutover parity `45084273086`.
- UniFFI binding generation and three-ABI NDK builds previously green with committed native artifacts and provenance.
- Emulator ART parity green via runs `45083247641` and `45084273055`; 3 tests, 0 failures/errors.
- Final pre-cutover matrix on `98f686b` all green; `gh pr checks 73` was 12/12 pass.
- PR #73 is merged as commit `a7d6ffd` (“Stage 2 evidence: fix Kotlin defects, freeze golden oracle, record JVM baseline (#73)”).
- D-7/D-8 recorded in `docs/migration/decision-log.md`; DD-6/DD-7 marked superseded and DD-12 added in `docs/migration/delegated-decisions.md`.
- `.github/workflows/migration-golden-vectors.yml` rewritten as verification-only: corpus inventory, `sha256sum -c`, size check, structural self-checks.
- `common-interfaces/src/main/kotlin/com/watermelon/common/subtitle/SubtitlePorts.kt` added with `SrtParserPort`, `SubtitleHasherPort`, `SubtitleOffsetConsensus`, `PcmChunk`, `SpeechAccumulator`, `SpeechAccumulatorFactory`.
- `rust/crates/ffi/src/lib.rs` expanded from 4 to 14 exports; new exports cover all ten golden-vector components.
- New UniFFI Kotlin names expected: `openSubtitlesHash`, `timeMapJson`, `driftApplyJson`, `driftTimestampJson`, `correlateJson`, `consensusResolveJson`, `consensusHasUsefulProvisionalOffsetJson`, `probeSelectJson`, `activityBuildJson`, `speechAccumulatorJson`; new record `PcmChunk`.
- Existing exports unchanged: `bidiIsRtl`, `bidiFormat`, `srtParseJson`, `pcmCopySpikeJson`.
- Current local `main` and `origin/main` are synced at `94b3302`; work commits `de01e70` and `94b3302` were pushed.

### Active
- GitHub Actions run `45096836202` for `migration-uniffi-spike.yml` is regenerating the Kotlin binding and NDK libraries from the expanded FFI; background watch is waiting for completion.
- Need to replace stale `app/src/main/kotlin/uniffi/watermelon_ffi/watermelon_ffi.kt` and committed `.so` files with artifacts from run `45096836202`.
- Need to implement Rust-backed Kotlin adapters and rewire production call sites without Kotlin fallback.
- Need to delete the ten Kotlin port implementations and Kotlin-only tests/generators/benchmarks that reference them.
- Need to update device parity test/workflow, docs, Stage 6 status, native artifact hashes, and CI evidence with exact new run IDs.

### Blocked
- Kotlin adapter code cannot compile until the generated UniFFI binding from run `45096836202` is committed.
- No physical-device soak test is available; physical-device performance cannot be claimed.
- Old branch `migration/golden-oracle-scaffolding` no longer exists locally or on `origin`; work is on `main`.

## Next Move
1. When run `45096836202` completes, download `migration-uniffi-spike` and `migration-ndk-libraries` artifacts; replace the generated Kotlin binding and three `.so` files; update `docs/migration/native-artifacts.md` hashes.
2. Implement Kotlin adapters over the new UniFFI API; use `common-interfaces` ports to inject Rust-backed implementations into `SubtitleRepositoryImpl`, `LocalSidecarSourceImpl`, `SparseSpeechProbeSource`, `SubtitleSyncCoordinator`, and `AppDependencies`.
3. Delete the ten Kotlin ports: `SrtParser` Kotlin implementation, `BidiFormatter`, `OpenSubtitlesHasher`, `SyncModelTimeMapper`, `LinearDriftCorrector`, `ActivityCorrelatorImpl`, `OffsetConsensus`, `SubtitleProbeSelectorImpl`, `SubtitleActivityBuilderImpl`, `SpeechLikelihoodAccumulator`.

## Relevant Files

- `app/build.gradle.kts`: default-off migration flags to remove; JNA dependency to keep.
- `.github/workflows/migration-uniffi-spike.yml`: CI source of regenerated binding and native libraries.
- `.github/workflows/migration-golden-vectors.yml`: now verification-only for frozen oracle.
- `.github/workflows/migration-device-parity.yml`: flags/path filters need Rust-only update.
- `.github/workflows/migration-rust-parity.yml`: keep; verifies Rust against frozen Kotlin corpus.
- `rust/crates/core/src/bin/parity.rs`: existing ten-component parity evaluator and D-3 comparator.
- `docs/migration/decision-log.md`: D-7/D-8 owner decisions.
- `docs/migration/delegated-decisions.md`: DD-6/DD-7 supersession and DD-12 oracle preservation.
- `docs/migration/native-artifacts.md`: native artifact provenance and hashes to refresh.

## Important Context
- Current `main` head is `94b3302`; `origin/main` is synced; PR #73 is already merged.
- Run `45096836202` is the active UniFFI/NDK regeneration from head `94b3302`; do not use older binding/native artifacts.
- `openSubtitlesHash` returns error JSON for inputs under 131072 bytes; production hashing targets media files, not small subtitle files.

- Use `env -u GH_TOKEN gh ...` for all GitHub CLI/API calls.

## Cutover and rollback design (activated, default-off)

`app/build.gradle.kts` defines three compile-time flags, all defaulting to `false`:
`watermelon.useRustCore`, `watermelon.rustShadowMode` and `watermelon.rustDebugLogging`.
`MigrationFlags`, `RustMigrationLog`, `RustBridge`/`RustBridgeImpl`, `MigrationDiagnostics` and
`RustCutover` implement the D-4 seam and the Stage 5 cutover. `AppDependencies` installs
`RustCutover` only when the flag is on; `MigrationDiagnostics` calls native code only when both
shadow flags are on and always returns the Kotlin value.

Rollback triggers to apply before any flag is enabled in a non-local build:

1. Any non-numeric mismatch under the D-3 tolerance, or any integer/Long/hash mismatch, in the
   39-case JVM corpus → revert to the Kotlin implementation and stop.
2. Any mismatch on the owner-approved on-device protocol → revert and record the device, media
   and raw outputs before changing code.
3. A native-library load failure, missing ABI, or exception from the bridge → revert; shadow mode
   must never turn into a user-visible crash.
4. Any new telemetry, upload or non-debug logging → revert; D-4 permits local opt-in logging only.
5. A new dependency or APK packaging change must be reviewed and pinned. JNA `5.19.1@aar` was
   added under the owner's delegation (DD-5), with hashes in `gradle/verification-metadata.xml`
   and provenance in [native-artifacts.md](native-artifacts.md).

# Stage 6 report: cleanup and Rust-only cutover

**Branch:** `main` · **Stage:** 6 of 6 · **Status:** DONE under owner decisions D-7/D-8

## Decision history

The earlier version of this report recorded Stage 6 as deliberately deferred (DD-7), because the
release default was Kotlin and the frozen oracle plus the rollback path depended on the Kotlin
ports. The owner subsequently chose:

- **D-7:** delete only the ten superseded, oracle-covered Kotlin ports;
- **D-8:** make Rust the sole runtime and remove the fallback/degradation scaffolding.

DD-6 (opt-in reversible cutover) and DD-7 (defer deletion) are superseded. Rollback is now a
Git/release operation, not an in-app flag.

## What changed

### Deleted Kotlin implementations (ten)

`SrtParser`, `BidiFormatter`, `OpenSubtitlesHasher`, `SubtitleTimeMapper`, `LinearDriftCorrector`,
`ActivityCorrelatorImpl`, `OffsetConsensus`, `SubtitleProbeSelectorImpl`,
`SubtitleActivityBuilderImpl` and `SpeechLikelihoodAccumulator`.

Their Kotlin-only characterization, unit, golden-generator and benchmark tests were deleted with
them. `GoldenJson.kt` and the structural self-check tests remain, as does the frozen corpus.

### Removed cutover scaffolding

`MigrationFlags`, `RustMigrationLog`, `RustBridge`, `RustBridgeImpl`, `MigrationDiagnostics` and
`RustCutover`, together with the `-Pwatermelon.useRustCore`, `-Pwatermelon.rustShadowMode` and
`-Pwatermelon.rustDebugLogging` Gradle properties and their `BuildConfig` fields. JNA packaging
was kept; it is required by the generated UniFFI binding.

### Added Rust-only seams and adapters

`common-interfaces/.../SubtitlePorts.kt` declares `SrtParserPort`, `SubtitleHasherPort`,
`SubtitleOffsetConsensus`, `PcmChunk`, `SpeechAccumulator` and `SpeechAccumulatorFactory`.
`app/.../migration/RustAdapters.kt` implements them over the UniFFI exports. `AppDependencies`
injects those adapters unconditionally into the repository, sidecar source, speech probe source and
sync coordinator. `SubtitleHasherPort` passes only the first and last 64 KiB of a media file, so a
multi-gigabyte video is never copied into native memory.

## Exit criteria

| Criterion | State |
|---|---|
| Superseded Kotlin implementations removed | Done: exactly the ten oracle-covered ports |
| No Kotlin fallback remains | Done: no runtime switch, flags or shadow scaffolding |
| `verify_interfaces.py` updated | Not applicable: removed classes were additions/ports; shared contracts were kept |
| Golden oracle preserved | Done: corpus frozen and workflow converted to verification-only (DD-12) |
| Docs archived | Superseded by current reports linked from [PLAN.md](PLAN.md) |

## Evidence limits

ART evidence is from the pinned x86_64 API 35 emulator only. No physical-device soak test was
performed and no device performance number is claimed.

## Related documents

- [PLAN.md](PLAN.md) · [Stage 5 report](stage-5-report.md)
- [Decision log](decision-log.md) D-7/D-8 · [Delegated decisions](delegated-decisions.md) DD-6, DD-7, DD-12
